title: Benchmark discovery and measurement
behavioral_concerns: Authoring occurs only in disposable copies and may promote only new bounded measurement test or performance testdata files after frozen correctness checks.
Discovery accepts only exact immediately preceding markers in contained regular Go test files and proves complete unique target coverage.
Manifest identity, parser version, output identity, exact argv, package locator, symbol, and raw unit are product-owned and digest-frozen.
Measurement commands cannot mutate the frozen disposable benchmark workspace or canonical target.
Process environments are allowlisted, executions are serial, and output truncation, ambiguity, identity drift, process failure, or uncertain cleanup blocks qualification.
Warmups are excluded, complete declared sample sets are required, medians are exact, and CV equal to the configured maximum is valid.

evidence.summary: The discovery loop retains a pending descriptor across blank and comment lines, contradicting the same file's immediate-precedence contract.

theories.claim: Performance manifest discovery accepts descriptor markers separated from a function declaration by blank lines or additional comments, despite requiring the marker to immediately precede the function.
theories.basis: qa-v1-block-1b60986a6ab4bfd58330b6d6 documents immediate precedence, but discoverPerformanceFile continues past empty and comment lines while a marker is pending.
theories.confirmation_condition: DiscoverPerformanceManifest accepts a contained *_test.go file having a valid marker, an intervening blank or comment line, and then a matching function.
theories.refutation_condition: Discovery rejects every marker whose next source line is not its function declaration.
theories.inconclusive_condition: The product definition of immediately preceding explicitly permits intervening blank or comment lines, contrary to qa-v1-block-1b60986a6ab4bfd58330b6d6.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Use static inspection or a temporary-file unit test with a blank or unrelated comment between a valid marker and function, then call DiscoverPerformanceManifest without modifying product files.
